metadata.question: Was the increase in nighttime light intensity in Antakya, the capital of Türkiye’s Hatay Province, greater on February 21, 2023 than April 30, 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Antakya, Hatay Province, Turkey (approximately 36.2°N, 36.16°E) - Dates: February 21, 2023 and April 30, 2023 - Collection: VIIRS nighttime lights (NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG or daily data) - Need to compare nighttime light intensity between these two dates 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for nighttime lights - Focus on the radiance band (avg_rad or avg_rade9h) 3. Logic: - Calculate mean nighttime light intensity for both dates - Compare: If Feb 21 > Apr 30, answer A (Yes) - If Feb 21 <= Apr 30, answer B (No) - Handle cases where data is missing (C1), no valid pixels (C2), or calculation fails (C3) Note: The question asks about "increase" on those dates, which is ambiguous. I'll interpret this as comparing the absolute light intensity values on those two dates. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Antakya location (capital of Hatay Province, Turkey) const antakya = ee.Geometry.Point([36.16, 36.2]); const region = antakya.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around city center // Date ranges for the two comparison dates const date1Start = '2023-02-01'; const date1End = '2023-02-28'; const date2Start = '2023-04-01'; const date2End = '2023-04-30'; console.log('Analyzing nighttime lights in Antakya, Turkey'); console.log('Date 1: February 2023'); console.log('Date 2: April 2023'); // Load VIIRS nighttime lights monthly composites const viirs1 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterDate(date1Start, date1End) .filterBounds(region); const viirs2 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterDate(date2Start, date2End) .filterBounds(region); const count1 = viirs1.size().getInfo(); const count2 = viirs2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 2023 Images: ${count1}`); console.log(`Apr 2023 Images: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('Missing data for one or both periods'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get the first (and typically only) image from each period const img1 = viirs1.first(); const img2 = viirs2.first(); // Calculate mean nighttime light intensity for both periods const stats1 = img1.select('avg_rad').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2 = img2.select('avg_rad').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); // Also get pixel counts const count_stats1 = img1.select('avg_rad').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const count_stats2 = img2.select('avg_rad').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const intensity1 = stats1.get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const intensity2 = stats2.get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const pixels1 = count_stats1.get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const pixels2 = count_stats2.get('avg_rad').getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 2023: Intensity=${intensity1}, Pixels=${pixels1}`); console.log(`Apr 2023: Intensity=${intensity2}, Pixels=${pixels2}`); if (pixels1 === 0 || pixels2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in one or both periods'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (intensity1 === null || intensity2 === null || isNaN(intensity1) || isNaN(intensity2) || intensity1 < 0 || intensity2 < 0) { console.log('Invalid calculation results'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare intensities console.log(`Difference (Feb - Apr): ${(intensity1 - intensity2).toFixed(4)}`); if (intensity1 > intensity2) { console.log('February 2023 had higher nighttime light intensity'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('April 2023 had equal or higher nighttime light intensity'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
